protocol: Four repeated 20-minute acute hypoxia exposures per volunteer, at 350 mmHg and 20,000 ft.

protocol: Five volunteers in a single-blind crossover. Stepwise chamber exposure to a peak of 13,500 ft. ANP condition.
locator: Protocol B, p. 411, and Study B, p. 412
note: Three episodes occurred while seated and two upon standing. The full text distinguishes one documented loss of consciousness from the combined syncope or near-syncope endpoint.

protocol: Five volunteers in a single-blind crossover. Stepwise chamber exposure to a peak of 13,500 ft. Placebo condition.
locator: Protocol B, p. 411, and Study B, p. 412
note: No adverse reaction was reported during hypoxic exposure without ANP. These five people took part in both conditions.

protocol: Hypobaric chamber training report. Altitude is the simulated peak in the stated profile.

protocol: Simulated chamber exposure in nine volunteers. Altitude is the planned peak.
outcome_window: During chamber exposure, about four minutes into the hypoxic segment.
note: Source places loss of consciousness at 25,400 ft and reports profound desaturation. Eight volunteers completed the full profile. The paper discusses DCS risk separately and gives no adjudicated DCS tally.
